705440101.text: Ohoho! So this is the rumored sacred land that people name the Furball Fortress! And yet it is furnished in such a prosaic manner — shabby, one might even call it.

705440102.text: Surely a few... swings woven from the vines of purple agate grapes might be built! Pure silver lamps mounted with candles made of abyssal sea salt, all the better to light the cat-feeding platters with the motifs of nightborne stars!

705440103.text: And... Yes, statues! Forged in the image of cat familiars by melting the venerable coinage of lost dynasties and adorning them with strange pearls and dewdrops from the depths of a fjord. Surely, this would make for an amenable choice!

705440104.text: You surely must agree, do you not, dear familiar...

705440105.text: ...Hmm. You have yet to declare your name to your Prinzessin. Think on that, then, and know that it shall be your utmost honor to be known to her!

705440108.text: Dopey isn't the brightest, and he can't really understand or appreciate your exquisite choice of words. Please, show him clemency, Prinzessin...

705440109.text: Hey, wait, no, that's not right! Why does Paimon get like this whenever she sees Fischl?

705440112.text: Haha, as I anticipated! Cat Conjurors, thou hath once more been brought before our august person by the weavings of the threads of fate...

705440114.text: What a title... Looks like Fischl heard about us from Valerina!

705440115.text: By your counsel, much thought have I given of late within Immernachtreich to realize the ingenuities obtained from prior experiences, and...

705440116.text: I have decided to select the most sagacious and sensible of cat familiars to accompany my eminent person on my sojourns!

705440118.text: Oh, so you were also planning on taking care of a cat, Fischl? Well, understandable. Most people want to have their own after seeing just so how adorable they are!

705440119.text: But Fischl, don't you already have Oz?

705440120.text: And the two of you tend to move really fast, can a cat keep up? Or... Are you gonna have Oz fly while carrying the cat?

705440121.text: Hmph! I, the Prinzessin der Verurteilung, often traverse three thousand universes. Though such a journey may not be long, having more suitable companions and gaining insight into things easily overlooked... naturally wouldn't hurt.

705440122.text: Oz also would like to have a cat familiar to play... *cough* Ahem, to join forces with to guarantee that my mood shall shine bright as moonlight every second of every day!

705440123.text: Yet, 'tis a shame that though Oz went to great pains to don a form that sets most at ease, he could not diminish his majesty fully, and could not approach the cat familiars.

705440124.text: Whenever dear Oz gets within five paces of a cat familiar, their fur shall inadvertently stand on end and inflate like a Bloatty Floatty unmoored. Any closer, and terror overtakes them, and they flee for the hills.

705440125.text: The Anemo Archon's devoted and loyal nuns recommended that Oz repose without, and as their advice was sound, I graciously assented.

705440126.text: Majesty? Oh, right, Paimon gets it...

705440127.text: You mean that Oz's body has so much Electro energy that the second he enters the Furball Fortress, all the feline fur gets electri-fried, right?

705440128.text: But if that's true, then how could a cat ever travel with you, Fischl...?

705440129.text: If only there was some material in Teyvat that could block the effects of Electro!

705440130.text: Then we could make cat clothes out of that material, and then a cat could travel with you and Oz, no problem!
